_comment: Phase 1.6 A5.1 — FIRST official-protocol training. 4900 train clips stratified (7 per scene × ALL 700 train scenes covered) from TRAIN pkl + /data NFS rgb. Preview = 4 train_seen (different train scenes) + 8 held_out_scenes (val pkl, /local SSD rgb). Per §13.11/13.13: data is calibration-aware, model condition is pseudo pano-half ID. raymap NOT integrated (precomputed at runs/phase16_raymap/, gated to A5.2).
_data: Train: train pkl + /data/.../nuscenes-360/train RGB, indices loaded from runs/phase16_a51/train_indices.json (5000 clips, 625 unique train scenes). Val/preview: ConcatDataset of (train pkl 4 train_seen) + (val pkl 8 held_out). Per-slot deterministic preview seed via inference_config.preview_seed_base.
_dtype_strategy: fp32 base / bf16 FSDP compute / fp32 reduce / no grad_scaler. WHY: ctsd.py:866-868 does `model.to(dtype=self.model_dtype)` BEFORE FSDP wrap, so writing model_dtype=fp16 means FSDP's 'sharded params kept in full precision outside fwd/bwd' would actually be fp16 — not real fp32 master. Omit model_dtype → defaults to fp32 → FSDP master is real fp32. Then mixed_precision.param_dtype=bf16 (compute), reduce_dtype=fp32 (gradient allreduce precision), buffer_dtype=fp32. autocast also bf16 (default cuda autocast = fp16 — must match FSDP compute dtype). enable_grad_scaler=false (bf16 doesn't need it). Matches PyTorch FSDP2 tutorial canonical pattern.
_preview_indices_note: preview cycle len 12 = 4 train_seen + 8 held_out (multiple of 4 → no DDP truncation). train_seen indices into train pkl: [4931, 2097, 11208, 18624]; held_out indices into val pkl: [500, 535, 563, 592, 620, 652, 690, 723]. ConcatDataset slot mapping: slots [0..3] → train_seen, slots [4..11] → held_out.
_mesh_note: mesh_shape=[4] (1D, single node × 4 GPUs). PyTorch FSDP1 docs: 'FULL_SHARD = 1D mesh; HYBRID_SHARD = 2D mesh'. Earlier [1,4] caused FSDP to take the OUTER dim (size 1) → world_size=1 → silent fallback to NO_SHARD → fp16 model + grad_scaler → NaN. Confirmed via PyTorch FSDP API doc (https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/fsdp.html).
